item.why: In overdose records from 27 US states, only 7 of 91 such deaths had kratom alone. Other drugs turned up in the rest, and fentanyl was named as a cause in 51.

item.statement: Most volunteers in one lab study ranked one session on psilocybin, the magic-mushroom drug, among their 5 most meaningful experiences.
item.why: Two months later, 67 in 100 did. But everyone in that study already took part in religious or spiritual activities, which may have made them see it as more spiritual.
